{{Quote|Watch him, Chewie. He's had too much nikta to drink.|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 8">[[Star Wars (1977) 8|''Star Wars'' (1977) 8]]</ref>}}
'''Nikta''' was a popular [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] drink. [[Warto]] was drunk on the beverage when he picked a fight with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[Locru's Central Saloon]].
